SELECT
  member_model_src_10000.tier AS member__tier
  , SUM(subq_5.__order_count) AS order_count
  , SUM(subq_5.__valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  , SUM(subq_5.__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
FROM (
  SELECT
    member_id AS member
    , 1 AS __order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."order_fact" order_model_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
) subq_5
LEFT OUTER JOIN
  "data"."main"."members" member_model_src_10000
ON
  subq_5.member = member_model_src_10000.member_id
GROUP BY
  member_model_src_10000.tier

question: 我想比较青禾2026年6月不同会员等级：逐组给出创建订单数、有效订单数、净销售额，金额保持分。
